summary: Verified the name-resolution picker end-to-end on /kiosk plus regressions on Step-1 validation and the kiosk lead privacy shape. Backend: 7/7 pytest checks pass (resolve returns candidates for Adams/GA/M and Adams/FL/M with correct card fields, too_many=true for Smith/CA/J with count=36, case-insensitive query, kiosk POST /api/kiosk/leads response contains ONLY {id, spin_available} with no score/tier/dollar/medicare leak, end-to-end lead created via picker-selected NPI is match_status=confirmed with tiers computed and not GREY, one-spin enforcement enforced). Frontend: Step-1 Continue enables correctly across all 6 combinations (both/phone-only/email-only/neither/missing-first/missing-last); Step-2 picker (data-testid resolve-picker) appears after state=GA is selected with 8 candidate cards including resolve-1932157880 (Dr. Michael Adams · Savannah · General Surgery); switching state to FL re-queries and returns a different 7-card set; picking common name Smith/CA/J shows the too_many hint 'Add your NPI on the first screen for the fastest, most accurate match'; clicking Michael Adams card auto-fills city='Savannah' and specialty='General Surgery'; completing steps 2-3 and submitting navigates to /wheel/:id (verified 669fc592-a9a0-4fc1-b690-3bb77e38ea14) and GET /api/dashboard/leads/{id} returns match_status=confirmed, npi=1932157880, tier_340b=RED, tier_rpm=YELLOW.
critical_code_review_comments: Kiosk.js L58-64 resolveMatches() correctly clears candidates/tooMany when last_name or state is empty and short-circuits when an NPI is already entered — no stale picker state.
Kiosk.js L73 useEffect re-runs resolveMatches on step, state, last_name, first_name changes — good coverage for re-query on state change (verified GA→FL produced a different candidate set).
routes_kiosk.py L79-102: /api/kiosk/resolve does session_id + last_upper + state + first_initial match, returns count and a hard 12-cap into too_many — matches the picker contract exactly.
routes_kiosk.py L237 correctly returns ONLY {id, spin_available} — no score/tier/medicare leak (privacy contract verified).
Kiosk.js L74-78 selectCandidate only fills city/specialty if empty — safe against overwriting typed values.
test_credentials: Kiosk needs no login. Admin used to verify created lead: admin@boothiq.com / PIN 482913.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads in the shared live dataset during pytest, plus one UI-submitted lead id=669fc592-a9a0-4fc1-b690-3bb77e38ea14 for Michael Adams (NPI 1932157880, Savannah, General Surgery).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the resolve picker + kiosk privacy lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_resolve.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration6_resolve.py -v`. Adams/GA/M and Adams/FL/M are the reliable seed cases for candidate lists; Smith/CA/J and Patel/CA/A reliably trigger too_many (count 36 and 81 respectively). Michael Adams NPI 1932157880 is the anchor for confirmed-match end-to-end submits.
